# Pirsch Analytics — Style Reference

> Cream index cards on white bond paper, one mint tab clipped on. DM Sans at weight 500 sets every heading on a #ffffff canvas, cream tiles carry a 6% inset pencil line, and a mint slab holds the only call.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Pirsch speaks a cream-tile ledger language: a pure #ffffff canvas carries cream #f8f5ed tiles (28 uses), and a translucent #0000000a wash fills chips and secondary buttons. The chromatic budget is two hues. Mint #6ece9d is the action color and the only colored line, and sunbeam #ffda6e fills one trial button, review stars and the warm gradient blooms behind the page. Typography is a single family, DM Sans, at only two weights. Weight 500 sets everything from a 14px tracked eyebrow to a 96px display, so hierarchy comes from size jumps of 1.5× (96 to 64) and 2.3× (64 to 28) and from a black #000000 versus pewter #707070 split. Weight is held constant. Shape stays rounded at 24px for cards and 12px for buttons. Elevation is a 1px inset ring at 6% black, never a drop shadow, plus a mint bloom behind the hero dashboard. The page reads as a calm printed product brochure rather than a growth-hacking SaaS landing page.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Body background, nav bar fill and the white stat panels nested inside the hero dashboard. It keeps the page bright so the cream tiles register as a material shift. |
| Cream Tile | `#f8f5ed` | `--color-cream-tile` | Feature cards and the hero dashboard frame, 28 uses. It is the system's only true surface color, warm enough to read as paper against white. |
| Fog Wash | `#0000000a` | `--color-fog-wash` | Secondary button fill, data-point chips and eyebrow pills, 15 uses. As a 4% black overlay it tints whatever sits beneath it, white or cream. |
| Jet Ink | `#000000` | `--color-jet-ink` | Every heading, nav label and button label, including text on mint and yellow fills, 85 uses. Pure black at weight 500 delivers authority without bold. |
| Pewter Caption | `#707070` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Hero subtitle, card body copy and the social-proof caption, 90 uses and the most frequent text color. The gray carries the second tier of hierarchy that weight does not. |
| Ash Hairline | `#0000000f` | `--color-ash-hairline` | The 1px inset ring on every cream card and the top edge of the hero frame. It replaces borders and shadows in one stroke. Do not darken it past 6%. |
| Mint Signal | `#6ece9d` | `--color-mint-signal` | Primary CTA fills, the nav trial button and the 2px active-tab ring in the dashboard mockup. It is the single action hue. Do not use it for headings or body text. |
| Mint Halo | `#6ece9d59` | `--color-mint-halo` | The resting glow on CTAs and the 120px bloom behind the hero dashboard. This 35% mint is light, not paint, so do not use it as a fill. |
| Sunbeam Accent | `#ffda6e` | `--color-sunbeam-accent` | The "Start 30-day Free Trial" button, rating stars and warm background blooms, 9 uses. It is the warm counterweight to mint. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |

## Tokens — Typography

### DM Sans — the single geometric grotesk that sets display, UI and body at two weights · `--font-dm-sans`

- **Substitute:** DM Sans itself from Google Fonts at 400 and 500, which is free and the first choice. Inter at 400 for body and 500 for headings, with an extra -0.5px tracking at 64px and above, because Inter's taller x-height reads about one weight-step heavier at display sizes. Manrope at 500 for headings only. DM Sans draws true to its nominal weight: its 500 renders as a firm medium rather than a semibold, so no substitute should go to 600.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 14px, 16px, 18px, 20px, 24px, 28px, 36px, 64px, 96px
- **Line height:** 1.25 (24px and above), 1.5 (14 to 20px), 2.22 (18px dropdown rows at 40px)
- **Letter spacing:** -2px at 96px, -1px at 64px, 4px at 14px uppercase eyebrows, 0px everywhere else
- **OpenType features:** `"ss03"`, `"ss04"`
- **Role:** Holding every heading at weight 500 is the signature. A 96px headline in medium instead of the conventional 700 lands heavy through size and stays calm through stroke. The scale ignores the usual modular ratios: 96 to 64 is a Perfect Fifth (1.5), and 64 to 28 skips 2.3×, so a section title and a card title are separated by a deliberate gap rather than the gradual Major Third steps of most SaaS sites. Negative tracking of -2px and -1px tightens only the two display tiers. The 4px positive tracking on uppercase 14px eyebrows is the one place the face goes wide. Stylistic sets ss03 and ss04 are enabled on 175 elements, an alternate-glyph choice that fallbacks will not reproduce.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | DM Sans | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | DM Sans | 500 | 14px | 1.5 | 4px | `--text-caption` |
| body | DM Sans | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | DM Sans | 400 | 18px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | DM Sans | 500 | 20px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | DM Sans | 500 | 24px | 1.25 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | DM Sans | 500 | 28px | 1.25 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | DM Sans | 500 | 64px | 1.25 | -1px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | DM Sans | 500 | 96px | 1.25 | -2px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every heading, button label and nav link at weight 500, from 14px eyebrows to the 96px display — size and the #000000/#707070 split carry hierarchy, so weight stays constant.
- Edge every cream #f8f5ed card with `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset` — the inset ring defines the shape without lifting it off the page.
- Reserve #6ece9d for primary CTA fills and 2px active rings — one action hue makes the next step unmistakable.
- Put #000000 text on both mint and yellow fills — black clears contrast on these light hues where white would fail.
- Track display type negatively, -2px at 96px and -1px at 64px, and leave everything under 64px at 0px — tightening applies only where letterforms are large enough to need it.
- Space sections 192px apart and pad cards 48px — that generosity is the reason a two-weight, two-hue system feels unhurried.
- Keep one radius per tier — 24px cards, 12px buttons, 6px nav and chips — because a non-negotiable step-down keeps nested shapes concentric.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 700 — the medium-weight voice at 96px is the identity, and a heavier stroke turns it into a generic SaaS hero.
- Don't add `0 8px 24px` drop shadows to cream cards — floating tiles break the printed-paper logic that the 6% hairline establishes.
- Don't swap the cream #f8f5ed for a cool gray like a Tailwind slate-50 — the warm tile against #ffffff is the only surface contrast the page has.
- Don't make #ffda6e the main CTA — sunbeam is limited to one trial button and the stars, and doubling it splits the action signal.
- Don't set body copy in #000000 — #707070 at 18px weight 400 is what lets 500-weight black headings stand forward without bold.
- Don't use pill-shaped 9999px buttons — the 12px corner matches the 24px card family, and full pills belong to a different shape vocabulary.
- Don't track normal-case text wider than 0px — the 4px spacing is reserved for uppercase 14px eyebrows and should never leak into body or headings.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- card surface: #f8f5ed (Cream Tile)
- primary text: #000000 (Jet Ink)
- secondary text: #707070 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #0000000f (Ash Hairline)
- tinted fill: #0000000a (Fog Wash)
- warm accent: #ffda6e (Sunbeam Accent)
- primary action: #6ece9d (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use #6ece9d as solid 2px lines and thin bar underlines, with area fills held to the 35% #6ece9d59 halo. Axes, labels and gridlines stay in #707070 and #0000000f, so the mint CTA remains the loudest object on any screen.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: background #6ece9d, text #000000, no border, border-radius 12px, padding 0px 24px, height 48px, font DM Sans 18px weight 500, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0px, box-shadow `rgba(110, 206, 157, 0.35) 0px 0px 0px 0px`. Pair it 16px to the left of a secondary button with identical geometry, background #0000000a and no shadow. Both labels are #000000 and use no icons.
2. Build a hero section on #ffffff: center a DM Sans 96px weight 500 headline, line-height 1.25, letter-spacing -2px, #000000. Below it, at 32px, add an 18px weight 400 #707070 paragraph capped at 768px. Add the button pair 48px below, then an avatar row (100% radius, 8px overlap) with five #ffda6e stars and a 14px #707070 caption 24px lower. Close with a 1200px-wide #f8f5ed dashboard frame, border-radius 24px 24px 0px 0px, box-shadow `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px -1px 0px 0px, rgba(110, 206, 157, 0.35) 0px -40px 120px -40px`, placed 64px below.
3. Build a feature card: background #f8f5ed, border-radius 24px, padding 48px, box-shadow `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset`, backdrop-filter blur(24px), no border. Title in DM Sans 28px weight 500, line-height 1.25, #000000. Body 16px below it in 18px weight 400, line-height 1.5, #707070. Lay two cards in a 2:1 grid with a 32px gap.
4. Build a navigation bar: position fixed, height 88px, background #ffffff, no border or shadow, content constrained to 1200px. Place the logo left. On the right, add Product, Solution and Resources dropdown triggers (DM Sans 16px weight 500, #000000, height 36px, border-radius 6px, 6px caret gap), then Pricing and Log In links 24px apart, then a button with background #6ece9d, text #000000, border-radius 6px, padding 0px 16px, height 36px, 16px weight 500.

## Components

### Mint Button — Large (Primary)

**Role:** Hero and closing conversion action

A soft-cornered mint slab. It uses a #6ece9d background, #000000 text, no border, a 12px radius, 0px 24px padding and a 48px height, set in DM Sans at 18px weight 500, with the `rgba(110, 206, 157, 0.35) 0px 0px 0px 0px` halo parked at rest. Black on mint instead of the conventional white keeps contrast legible on a light green. Use it once per viewport for "Start Your Free Trial" or "Get Started For Free".

### Tinted Button — Secondary

**Role:** Lower-commitment companion action

A translucent gray partner. It uses a #0000000a fill, #000000 text, no border, a 12px radius, 0px 24px padding and a 48px height, in DM Sans at 18px weight 500, with no shadow. It matches the primary's geometry exactly so the pair reads as one unit. Only the fill changes, which keeps "View Live Demo" quieter without demoting it to a text link.

### Mint Button — Compact (Nav)

**Role:** Persistent trial entry point

A shrunken version of the primary. It uses a #6ece9d fill, #000000 text, no border, a 6px radius, 0px 16px padding and a 36px height, in DM Sans at 16px weight 500, with the same resting `--shadow-md` halo. The radius drops from 12px to 6px to match the nav's dropdown triggers. Shape scales with size, so the 36px control does not look bloated.

### Sunbeam Button — Trial Variant

**Role:** Warm alternate conversion action

The system outlier. It uses a #ffda6e fill, #000000 text, no border, a 12px radius, 0px 24px padding and a 48px height, in DM Sans at 18px weight 500, and it still carries the mint `--shadow-md` halo. It appears once for "Start 30-day Free Trial." Yellow is allowed here because it marks a different offer than the mint CTAs. Rationing it to a single instance keeps mint the default.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Fixed top frame and wayfinding

A borderless white strip. It is fixed at 88px tall on #ffffff. The 90×28px logo and wordmark sit left, and the Product, Solution and Resources dropdown triggers sit right, each 36px tall with a 6px hover radius in DM Sans at 16px weight 500 #000000. Pricing and Log In follow, then the compact mint button. Dropdown links run in 252px columns at 16px weight 500. Without a hairline or shadow, the bar dissolves into the canvas.

### Feature Card — Cream Tile

**Role:** Primary content container for features

The workhorse tile. It uses a #f8f5ed fill, a 24px radius and 48px padding, with `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset` as its only edge and `backdrop-filter: blur(24px)` over the gradient blooms. The title is 28px weight 500 #000000 and the body is 18px weight 400 #707070. Cards tile in 2:1 and 1:2 splits (779px beside 389px) with 32px gutters. The inset ring makes the card a printed panel, not a floating object.

### Hero Dashboard Frame

**Role:** Product proof beneath the headline

A cream tray that bleeds downward. It is 1200px wide on #f8f5ed with a 24px 24px 0px 0px radius. The `--shadow-lg` pairing puts a 1px top hairline over a mint bloom that rises 40px and spreads 120px. White #ffffff inner panels at a 16px radius hold the stat row and session timeline. The open bottom edge fades into the canvas, so the real interface becomes the hero image instead of an illustration.

### Numbered Section Eyebrow

**Role:** Step marker above section headings

A tracked label capsule. It uses a #0000000a pill at a 20px radius with 4px 16px 4px 4px padding (estimated). A circular #0000000a counter at 100% radius holds the step number, followed by DM Sans at 14px weight 500, uppercase, with 4px tracking in #000000. "1 Easy Start" and "2 Instant Output" turn the long page into a numbered procedure, the only spot where wide tracking appears.

### Data Point Chip

**Role:** Enumerates trackable dimensions

Flat gray tokens. Each uses a #0000000a fill, a 6px radius, 6px 12px padding (estimated) and DM Sans at 16px weight 400 #000000. Chips are centered and wrapped with 12px gaps inside a cream card. They have no border and no hover state, so they read as an inventory of capabilities rather than clickable filters.

### Mint-Ring Tab — Dashboard Mockup

**Role:** Active state inside product UI

The only mint line in the system. Each tab is a 34px-tall control with a 6px radius and `rgb(110, 206, 157) 0px 0px 0px 2px` as its outline, in DM Sans at 16px weight 400 #000000. Four tabs (Overview, Dashboard, Funnels, Sessions) carry it. Mint outlines only selected states, a quieter alternative to the conventional filled pill tab.

### Social Proof Cluster

**Role:** Trust signal under hero CTAs

A compact credential row. Five avatar photos at a 100% radius overlap by 8px (estimated), followed by five #ffda6e stars and a "Trusted by 500+ Customers" caption in DM Sans at 14px weight 400 #707070. It sits 24px below the button pair. The yellow stars are the second permitted use of sunbeam, small enough to stay punctuation rather than decoration.

### Logo Wall

**Role:** Customer credibility strip

An unframed monochrome grid. Customer logos about 40px tall (measured 162×40px) sit in a 4-column by 2-row grid directly on #ffffff, with 48px row gaps (estimated) and no cards, borders or dividers. Logos are grayscale, so no third-party color breaks the two-hue budget.

### Theme Toggle Widget

**Role:** Floating light/dark switch

A small fixed capsule. It is pinned to the right edge at mid-viewport as a #ffffff pill with a 20px radius and the `--shadow-subtle` ring. A sun icon sits inside a #6ece9d circle at 100% radius, and a #000000 moon outline sits beside it, with 4px inner padding (estimated). This is the only floating element on the page, so it borrows the card's hairline instead of a drop shadow.

- **Mint and sunbeam CTAs at rest:** `rgba(110, 206, 157, 0.35) 0px 0px 0px 0px`
- **Hero dashboard frame:** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px -1px 0px 0px, rgba(110, 206, 157, 0.35) 0px -40px 120px -40px`

## Imagery

The dominant imagery is the product itself. The hero is a live-looking Pirsch dashboard showing acme.com, 136 active visitors, a stat row and a session timeline, rendered in HTML inside a cream #f8f5ed frame with a 24px top radius. Additional screenshots arrive as 1200×800px images at a 12px radius. There is no stock photography. The only photographs are the five 100%-radius customer avatars. Icons are thin outline glyphs in #000000 at roughly a 1.5px stroke (estimated), and the GDPR star ring is black line art. Behind the content sit soft radial blooms of #6ece9d and #ffda6e and a faint dot-grid texture (decorative, not a system token). Mockup-internal colors, including dark-green filter chips and red negative deltas, stay inside the dashboard. The narrative is that the product is the illustration.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1200px container inside a 1888px outer frame, with copy held to a 768px column. Sections are separated by 192px. The hero is centered: a 96px headline, an 18px #707070 subtitle, a mint and tinted button pair with 16px between, the avatar trust row, then the full-width dashboard frame bleeding into the next section. Sections follow one rhythm: numbered eyebrow, 64px heading, 18px lead paragraph, then a cream card grid in alternating 2:1 and 1:2 two-column splits with 32px gutters. The logo wall runs 4 columns by 2 rows. Pricing is not in the captured screens. The fixed nav is 88px tall and white-filled, with the logo left and menu plus CTA right. The footer is 1096px tall with 64px 16px padding. At 375px, use 64px for the display, 28px for section headings and 64px section gaps. Density: spacious.

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- card surface: #f8f5ed (Cream Tile)
- primary text: #000000 (Jet Ink)
- secondary text: #707070 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #0000000f (Ash Hairline)
- tinted fill: #0000000a (Fog Wash)
- warm accent: #ffda6e (Sunbeam Accent)

**Color in Data**

Charts use #6ece9d as solid 2px lines and thin bar underlines, with area fills held to the 35% #6ece9d59 halo. Axes, labels and gridlines stay in #707070 and #0000000f, so the mint CTA remains the loudest object on any screen.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: background #6ece9d, text #000000, no border, border-radius 12px, padding 0px 24px, height 48px, font DM Sans 18px weight 500, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0px, box-shadow `rgba(110, 206, 157, 0.35) 0px 0px 0px 0px`. Pair it 16px to the left of a secondary button with identical geometry, background #0000000a and no shadow. Both labels are #000000 and use no icons.
2. Build a hero section on #ffffff: center a DM Sans 96px weight 500 headline, line-height 1.25, letter-spacing -2px, #000000. Below it, at 32px, add an 18px weight 400 #707070 paragraph capped at 768px. Add the button pair 48px below, then an avatar row (100% radius, 8px overlap) with five #ffda6e stars and a 14px #707070 caption 24px lower. Close with a 1200px-wide #f8f5ed dashboard frame, border-radius 24px 24px 0px 0px, box-shadow `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px -1px 0px 0px, rgba(110, 206, 157, 0.35) 0px -40px 120px -40px`, placed 64px below.
3. Build a feature card: background #f8f5ed, border-radius 24px, padding 48px, box-shadow `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset`, backdrop-filter blur(24px), no border. Title in DM Sans 28px weight 500, line-height 1.25, #000000. Body 16px below it in 18px weight 400, line-height 1.5, #707070. Lay two cards in a 2:1 grid with a 32px gap.
4. Build a navigation bar: position fixed, height 88px, background #ffffff, no border or shadow, content constrained to 1200px. Place the logo left. On the right, add Product, Solution and Resources dropdown triggers (DM Sans 16px weight 500, #000000, height 36px, border-radius 6px, 6px caret gap), then Pricing and Log In links 24px apart, then a button with background #6ece9d, text #000000, border-radius 6px, padding 0px 16px, height 36px, 16px weight 500.

## Hairline Discipline

The system has exactly one structural line: a 1px inset ring at 6% black, #0000000f, drawn on 27 elements. It replaces borders, dividers and the conventional soft drop shadow at the same time, and the cream #f8f5ed tile does the rest of the separating. The discipline breaks the moment someone adds a `0 4px 12px` shadow to a card, raises the ring to 12% or 15% black, or adds a solid border for emphasis. Each of these reintroduces depth into a page that is deliberately flat as paper. To extend the system, put new containers on cream with the same inset ring and nest white panels at 16px inside them. The only light-based elevation is the mint bloom, reserved for the hero product frame.

## Mint Rationing

Mint #6ece9d holds four background-color uses on a page more than 9,000px tall, and all four are calls to action. Its only other appearances are as a 2px ring on active tabs and as a 35% halo. Sunbeam #ffda6e is the sanctioned exception, limited to one trial button, rating stars and background blooms. The ration breaks when mint is used for icons, section headings, link text or chart fills at full strength, because the eye then loses track of which mint means "click." To extend the system, give new states a neutral treatment first (#0000000a fill, #707070 text) and promote to mint only when the element is the single next action on its screen.

## Medium-Weight Hierarchy

Only weights 400 and 500 exist, so the 96px display, the 64px section title and the 14px eyebrow all share one stroke. Hierarchy is carried by size jumps of 1.5× and 2.3× and by the #000000 versus #707070 split. This is anti-convention for SaaS, where 600 to 700 headings are the default. The discipline breaks when a designer adds 600 or 700 for emphasis, or sets body copy in #000000 so headings must get bolder to stand out. To extend it, add a new tier by size from the existing scale, not by weight, and use tracking only at the extremes: -2px at 96px, -1px at 64px, and 4px on uppercase 14px labels.

## Similar Brands

- **Plausible Analytics** — It shares the privacy-first Google Analytics alternative pitch with a real dashboard as the hero image, but uses an indigo accent and denser feature lists instead of cream tiles.
- **Fathom Analytics** — It shares the cookie-free, consent-banner-free messaging and a single restrained action color, but leans on darker surfaces and heavier display weights.
- **Simple Analytics** — It shares EU-hosted privacy positioning and near-monochrome type hierarchy carried by size, but has no warm cream surface layer.
- **Umami** — It shares the open-source analytics dashboard presented as product proof on a white canvas, but with sharper corners and no gradient blooms.
- **Cal.com** — It shares the 1px low-opacity ring as the main card edge and the product-UI-as-hero composition, but uses a near-black primary instead of a colored CTA.
